title: 旅行专家Katy Nastro：邮轮也有隐藏费用？家庭出行需留意
speaker: Katy Nastro

segments.en: All right, before we let you go, it's not just flights. This is impacting cruises as well.
segments.zh: 好的，在结束之前，不只是机票，邮轮也受到了影响。

segments.en: Cruises are like the family bargain basement travel. I have so many friends who describe themselves as being really not cruise people, but then they need to do a vacation with tiny children and older parents and families who can't decide and they've all gone on a cruise and said, you know what, it was perfect, but it was affordable. It makes sense that people are looking at alternatives.
segments.zh: 邮轮就像是家庭的经济型旅行。我有很多朋友自称不是邮轮爱好者，但当他们需要带着小孩和老人一起度假，或者家人难以决定时，他们都选择了邮轮，并说“很完美，而且负担得起”。人们寻找替代方案是有道理的。

segments.en: We are looking at all-inclusive, domestic all-inclusive, Vegas just announced. Some of that is being implemented. Cruises always a family favorite because you know what your bottom line cost is going to be.
segments.zh: 我们也在关注全包式度假，国内全包式，拉斯维加斯刚刚宣布。有些已经在实施。邮轮一直是家庭的最爱，因为你知道总成本是多少。

segments.en: However, written into cruise contracts is little stipulations surrounding that there may be fees after the fact, even after you paid. Now, it varies across cruise lines, but that's something that travelers really need to be aware of.
segments.zh: 然而，邮轮合同中有些小条款规定，即使在付款后，也可能产生额外费用。不同邮轮公司规定不同，但旅客真的需要留意这一点。

segments.en: And unfortunately, again, it's looking to be a challenge for those cost-conscious travelers this year, specifically families.
segments.zh: 不幸的是，这对今年注重成本的旅客来说又是一个挑战，尤其是家庭。
